subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should a failed `redirectSessionKey` transcript write permanently suppress the operational notice from the source chat?
rationale: The branch intentionally chooses fail-closed confidentiality semantics, but this security-labeled product contract cannot be inferred safely from contributor or bot discussion alone.

options.title: Keep fail-closed redirect
options.body: Suppress the source notice and log the failed operator-session write so operational details cannot leak back to an external user.

options.title: Fall back to source delivery
options.body: Send the notice to the source chat when redirect persistence fails, preserving observability while accepting potential operational-detail exposure.

options.title: Remove redirect for now
options.body: Land only the modes whose failure semantics are already settled and defer operator-session redirection to a separately approved change.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed redirect
recommendation.body: Suppress the source notice and log the failed operator-session write so operational details cannot leak back to an external user.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this owner to heartbeat delivery, reply dispatch, session state, and the broader runtime contract.
